preconditions.expression: all(32 <= ord(c) <= 127 for line in stdin.splitlines() for c in line)
preconditions.description: Every character in each line has ASCII code between 32 and 127 (inclusive).
The total input size (including newlines) does not exceed 1,048,576 bytes.
The input ends with a newline character.
The input contains at least one non-newline character.

postconditions.expression: all(line == '' or line[0] != '#' or line[0] == ' ' for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Every non-empty line in the output either starts with a non-space character or is an amplifying line (starts with '#' possibly after spaces).

postconditions.expression: all(' ' not in line for line in stdout.splitlines() if not any(line.strip().startswith('#')))
postconditions.description: All spaces are removed from non-amplifying lines in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(line == '' or (line.strip().startswith('#') and line.strip() == '#' or line.strip().startswith('#') and line.strip()[1:].strip() != '' and line.strip()[1:].strip().startswith('#') is False) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Amplifying lines in the output are either empty or start with '#' (possibly after spaces) and are not followed by another amplifying line in the same line (i.e., no concatenation of amplifying lines).

postconditions.expression: all(line == '' or (line.strip().startswith('#') or (line.strip().startswith('#') is False and line.strip() != '')) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Every non-empty line in the output is either an amplifying line or a non-amplifying line.

postconditions.expression: all(line == '' or (line.strip().startswith('#') or (line.strip().startswith('#') is False and line.strip() != '')) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Non-amplifying lines in the output are concatenated only if they are consecutive and not separated by amplifying lines.

postconditions.expression: all(line == '' or (line.strip().startswith('#') or (line.strip().startswith('#') is False and line.strip() != '')) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Empty lines in the output are preserved only if they are surrounded by amplifying lines on both sides, or if they are the only line in the output.
